description: Vandam's exec-time process-tree classification lists, consulted by bprm_creds_for_exec and its worker helpers. trusted_admin_binaries: exec'ing one of these makes the process tree TREE_TRUSTED_ADMIN (a restricted-command tree, not full trust) - resolved by name via $PATH search, then registered by inode. admin_allowed_commands: commands a TREE_TRUSTED_ADMIN tree may still exec; anything else is denied, so this list IS the allowlist - a matched executable's basename decides membership, not its path. dangerous_tools / priv_esc_binaries: flagged in any threshold-monitored context regardless of tree type, also matched by basename. Replaces what used to be hardcoded arrays in vandam/src/lib.rs (admin_bins) and core/src/linux/ebpf_loader.cpp (PopulateExeNameClasses's kEntries) - see core's CLAUDE.md Known Debt history for why those existed as hardcoded arrays first.

trusted_admin_binaries.note: postrotate scripts exec other admin tools; this is the exception the tree classification exists for
invoked by logrotate/cron postrotate hooks and mail-enabled cron jobs
